EA FC 27 releases September 27, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Wishlist now: https://ninten.do/6006a6ATC 

Express yourself in and out of the stadium with The Grounds, an all-new social football playground where you can connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and more. Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay. Welcome to The World's Game!
